settings.heading: A little less guesswork.
settings.image_alt: A quiet bathroom with a freestanding bath and folded towels
settings.text: Small changes to washing, drying and moisturising. A practical place to start, without a longer routine.

settings.heading: Worth a read.
settings.note: Have a question about a formula? Start with the complete ingredient list, or ask us directly.

settings.image_alt: Calm wash on a wet stone ledge with soft foam
settings.title: Soft foam, on purpose.
settings.excerpt: A wash doesn't need a mountain of bubbles to earn a place in your bathroom.
settings.text:
Calm wash and Soft wash are made with a low-foam texture. Work a small amount between wet palms, then spread it over damp skin. The foam is soft and light.

Choose by how a formula feels during and after your shower, rather than by the size of its bubbles. You can find each wash's ingredient list in its quick view.

settings.image_alt: Oat bar with a debossed logo, soap foam and a few oat grains
settings.title: What's in an oat bar?
settings.excerpt: The full list, in plain sight. And what a bar changes about your daily wash.
settings.text:
Our Oat bar contains sodium olivate, sodium cocoate, oat milk, colloidal oat, shea butter and glycerin. It has no added fragrance.

A bar is a different format from our liquid washes. Keep it on a draining dish between uses so it can dry. The 120 g size is for face and body.

settings.image_alt: Little lotion beside a folded oat towel and a wicker basket
settings.title: A shorter shelf for little ones.
settings.excerpt: One light lotion, a towel, and a place for everything when bath time is done.
settings.text:
Little lotion is our fragrance-free oat lotion for ages 1 and up. The squeeze tube has an oat flip cap, so it can sit within easy reach on a dry shelf.

Keep your towel and lotion together if that makes the end of bath time simpler. Check the full ingredient list before choosing a new product for your child.

settings.image_alt: Body milk resting on a folded linen towel in gentle light
settings.title: Milk, lotion or cream?
settings.excerpt: Three textures. One decision: how much richness do you want to feel?
settings.text:
Body milk is the lightest, quickest-feeling option. Calm lotion is a light lotion for straight after the shower. Rich cream is our thickest texture, in a jar.

You don't need all three. Start with the texture you prefer and the areas you want to moisturise. See the ingredient lists alongside each product.

settings.image_alt: Golden Chamomile wash lying on linen among dried chamomile flowers
settings.title: The one with a little scent.
settings.excerpt: Chamomile is the exception in our line. Here's where to find the difference.
settings.text:
Chamomile wash is our only scented formula. It contains 0.2% chamomile flower oil. The ingredient list identifies its listed allergen, bisabolol.

Prefer no added fragrance? The other products in the line are fragrance-free. Choose the option that matches your own preferences and ingredient needs.

settings.image_alt: A single drop of cream wash hanging from a deep green pump
settings.title: When you want a richer wash.
settings.excerpt: A thicker texture for the days your usual wash feels a little too light.
settings.text:
Rich wash is the thicker body wash in our line. Its formula pairs the Calm wash base with extra shea butter and oat oil, and stays fragrance-free.

It comes in a 400 ml deep green bottle. If you also want a richer moisturiser, compare Rich cream with the lighter lotion and milk before adding another step.
